decision.economic_gate: No outer result may be scored or used for activation until the deterministic bridge validates the data audit, cost completeness, authority bindings, and exact-head governance.

pre_outcome_freeze.execution: broker-native executable prices with timestamped signal-to-fill sequencing
pre_outcome_freeze.features: session-gap definition and normalized reversion measurements from the authoritative freeze only
pre_outcome_freeze.missing_data: fail closed per symbol or interval; no imputation across executable gaps
pre_outcome_freeze.validation: preserve causal ordering and reserve the outer result from tuning

objective.goal: Define the smallest legally valid disjoint outer-data wave for the frozen C031 session-gap six-panel evaluation, including executable friction authority, without opening economics.
objective.information_gain_rationale: A prospective 16-week M5 panel outside all previously observed C031 data tests whether the session-gap mechanism survives across structurally diverse broker-native instruments; binding spread, commission, financing, and contract metadata prevents a false edge caused by unresolved costs.
